description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans serialization support for C# record types. It tests serialization and deserialization of various record structures, including abstract records, inherited records, record hierarchies, and records with collections. It also defines multiple record types with serialization attributes and demonstrates record usage in different scenarios.

classes.name: RecordSerializationTests
classes.description: Contains multiple test methods verifying serialization/deserialization of record types and hierarchies.

classes.name: EmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: An abstract record with serialization support, serving as a base for derived records.

classes.name: DerivedFromEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: A concrete record inheriting from EmptyAbstractRecord, with a serializable property.

classes.name: NonEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: An abstract record with a property, used as a base for further inheritance.

classes.name: DerivedFromNonEmptyAbstractRecord
classes.description: A record inheriting from NonEmptyAbstractRecord, with additional properties.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyDerived
classes.description: A record implementing a hierarchy with a property and an overridden property.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyMiddle
classes.description: An abstract record serving as a middle node in a hierarchy.

classes.name: RecordHierarchyBase
classes.description: An abstract base record with an abstract property.

classes.name: FooWithListOfObject
